name: beam_reach_capsize
description: Beam-on wind with the mainsheet hauled hard in. At 9 m/s the righting moment runs out: hold the sheet and the boat goes over in about ten seconds. The wind speed sits in the middle of the window measured in docs/v2/physics-validation.md: above 8.45 m/s the boat capsizes if the sheet is held, and below 9.65 m/s it recovers if the sheet is released at four seconds. The initial sheet length is the geometric minimum of v2 F18.1b, so the boom starts two-blocked on the centreline with no preload.
